    Walks of arrows out of a point with common upper bounds (Fischbacher §5.3) #

    An arrow walk out of c is a list of steps; a step joins two arrows ε₁, ε₂ out of c by a nonzero common upper bound ε₁ x = ε₂ y whose target satisfies a predicate P. The separation criterion at a minimal point (outComp_of_coboundary) gives such a walk between two arrows (exists_bwalk_of_outComp). A walk minimal for the Dershowitz–Manna order on the depths of its bounds has no trivial step, satisfies the valley conditions, has essential contours and distinct bound targets; these are the properties Fischbacher uses in §5.3.
